title: Goodreads Audiobook Weekly Book Length Trend
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodreads:audiobook hours_length=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(hours_length) as avg_duration, max(hours_length) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst book length for Goodreads audiobook events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture hours_length on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average book length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Goodreads audiobook tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
